key_findings: Review: CCL2/CCR2 drives chronic pain across peripheral sensitization, spinal central sensitization and supraspinal circuits.
CCL2/CCR2 contributes to NMDAR plasticity, glial activation, GABAergic disinhibition, and comorbid anxiety via ACC, CeA, NAc and hippocampus.
